context: A couple from Ohio with a folded map, Herald Square.

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_tourist
lines.text: Excuse me! The Empire Estate Building? The map says it's here. Here is very big.

choices.text: Two blocks up, east side of Fifth.

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_tourist
lines.text: Two blocks up, east side of Fifth. Thank you! New Yorkers are nice!

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_tourist
lines.text: Oh! Oh, there it is. It's right there. I feel foolish. Thank you.

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_tourist
lines.text: Any one? Okay… we'll write to the paper about this.

lines.speaker: npc.cab_fare_tourist
lines.text: Harold, say thank you to the nice… person.
